description: This PHP source file defines the class 'File' which extends the 'Basic' class. It manages file attachments within the SuiteCRM system, including properties for file metadata and methods for saving, retrieving, filling extra details, and deleting attachments. The code includes references to other included PHP files and handles file URL generation, preview display logic, and file deletion.

classes.name: File
classes.description: A class representing file attachments within SuiteCRM, providing properties for file metadata and methods to manage file saving, retrieval, display, and deletion.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the File object by calling parent constructor.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Overrides the save method to set the filename from the upload file before invoking the parent save.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_detail_fields
methods.description: Fills extra details for a File instance, such as image URL and preview display logic based on file extension and MIME type.

methods.name: retrieve
methods.description: Retrieves a File object by ID and sets the display name based on document_name.

methods.name: deleteAttachment
methods.description: Deletes the file attachment, removing the file from disk and resetting metadata.
